have experienced multiple issues with this practice, but recently it has become beyond unacceptable.

Two weeks ago, I called to book an appointment and was told the earliest available date was 31st March, which I agreed to and booked. While I was on holiday abroad, I then received a message confirming an appointment on 17th March — not only a different date, but also a different time.

As I was outside the country and unable to call, I sent an email to clarify the situation and followed up again due to a lack of response. In my messages, I clearly asked for confirmation of my original appointment on 31st March and requested cancellation of the incorrect booking on 17th March if necessary.

Instead, I received a message on the day stating that the appointment could not be cancelled and that I needed to call them. This was extremely frustrating, as I had already explained that I was unable to make phone calls while abroad. Additionally, there was no acknowledgement or confirmation regarding my original booking on 31st March.

This is not the first time I have experienced disorganisation from the administrative team, but this situation has been particularly stressful. I arranged time off work based on the confirmed 31st March appointment, and now I am left uncertain whether that booking even exists.

Overall, this reflects a serious lack of organisation, communication, and respect for patients’ time. I am extremely disappointed, especially as I chose this practice based on positive reviews.

Once this issue is resolved, I will not be returning. The level of stress and effort required to manage even basic administrative matters is unacceptable.

I would strongly advise others to avoid this
